meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

meanings.note: Внимание! = Attention!.

examples.text: А ну-ка, дай посмотрю! Внимание, ребята!
examples.trans: Hold on, let me have a look! Attention, everyone!

выходить.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.en: to go out, to come out
meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'ходить').

examples.trans: I'm going out in a minute.

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
Disbelief.

examples.text: Двести десять на сто тридцать девять!
examples.trans: Two hundred and ten over one hundred and thirty-nine!

examples.text: С тебя ровно двести тысяч рублей прямо сейчас.
examples.trans: That will be exactly two hundred thousand rubles right now.
Open the door. Is this flat nine?
Max: eight thousand nine hundred and fifty.

meanings.note: + genitive.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: Contrast дома = at home.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child
Old-fashioned.

examples.trans: I see, I see, you're a hero. Well done.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Stronger contrast than 'а'. Core Russian conj meaning 'but' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence
Ну, папа!. Core Russian part meaning 'well; come on' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)
meanings.note: Мы поедем = We'll be off. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'ехать').

examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.
Yes, and that's not the limit yet.

meanings.note: + genitive plural: пять рублей.

examples.text: Мы же только начинаем. Через месяц будет пять тысяч.
examples.trans: But we're only just starting. In a month there'll be five thousand.

meanings.note: the noun after it is genitive plural: пятьдесят метров

examples.text: Пятьдесят метров, не больше. Иначе будет сигнал.
examples.trans: Fifty metres, no more. Otherwise there'll be a signal.

examples.text: Я жду только одного — результатов от вас.
examples.trans: I expect only one thing: results from you.
This is an excellent result of the work.

examples.text: Я жду только одного — результатов от вас. Работайте!
examples.trans: I expect only one thing: results from you. Get to work!

meanings.note: + genitive plural.

examples.trans: There are seven hundred people here.
Seven hundred and fifty roubles. We've been saving for half a year.

meanings.note: the comparative 'тише' = quieter, used as 'shh'
тише! (comparative) = quiet! keep it down!

examples.trans: Why is the kitchen so quiet?

meanings.note: + genitive singular: три дня.

examples.trans: We give him three days. That's it.

meanings.note: the noun after it is genitive plural: тысячи мест

examples.text: Мы построим кластер. Это тысячи рабочих мест.
examples.trans: We will build the cluster. That means thousands of jobs.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine
Linking word: главное — это народ. Core Russian pron meaning 'this, that; it is' in everyday speech.

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'this, that; it is' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!
